qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dense regional brewery footprint and dominant route-to-market distribution in the Nordics, Western Europe, and high-growth Asian markets (China #1 in Western provinces, Vietnam, India). Demonstrated pricing power via premiumization and non-alcoholic portfolio.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Leading international brewer with dominant Nordic and Western European route-to-market scale and rapid Asian expansion (China, Vietnam, India). Strong pricing power with ROIC of 14.5% (37.6% tangible). Britvic acquisition expands non-alcoholic platform. Balance sheet leverage manageable with swift deleveraging track record. [5-10Y g: volume 1.0% + price/mix 2.5% + Asia/Britvic expansion 1.5% - margin drag 0.5% + buybacks 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 2024 ROIC reported at 14.5% (ex-goodwill 37.6%). NIBD/EBITDA stood at 1.65x in 2024 before the £3.3B Britvic transaction, with management targeting <2.5x leverage post-close. FCF conversion routinely exceeds 85%. Carlsberg Foundation ownership ensures long-term stewardship and prevents value-destroying mega-M&A.
